reasoning_traces.think:
The core contribution is a convolutional neural network with soft attention applied to multivariate time-series (MTS) order-flow data. The model treats each time-step as a 2D grid of features (variables) and uses causal convolutions to extract local temporal-spatial patterns. Soft attention is then applied to weigh these patterns adaptively, giving more importance to informative regions of the feature space. Roll padding is introduced to handle the MTS inputs without introducing artificial boundaries, preserving the cyclical nature of financial data. The architecture is trained end-to-end to predict the sign of future price changes (up/down) and demonstrates superior performance over standard LSTM and CNN baselines on a proprietary horse-racing betting exchange dataset. The empirical success suggests that combining convolutional feature extraction with attention mechanisms is effective for short-term forecasting in liquidity-constrained markets.
